card.name: Fine-print restriction phrases
card.fires_on: The word that completes a short restriction or disclaimer, such as 'valid', 'applicable', 'Not' (for oral use) or 'Information' in 'Important Safety Information'. Seen in offer terms and label headings.

modes.label: Offer terms
modes.description: Word in promo fine print saying where or to whom an offer applies.

modes.label: Not-for-use warnings
modes.description: 'Not' opening a route restriction after 'for topical use only'.
modes.example: AKLIEF Cream is for topical use only.<< Not>> for oral, ophthalmic, or

modes.label: Safety Information heading
modes.description: 'Information' ending the section title 'Important Safety Information'.
modes.example: 2.1 Important Safety<< Information>> BEQALZI can cause tumor

card.plain: It lights up on the key word in short fine-print lines, like offer limits and 'not for oral use' notes.
